projection.method: PCA on the 23 established practices' raw scores, centered, not scaled
projection.signConvention: Each axis is flipped if needed so that a reference dimension loads positively: exertion on axis 1, structure on axis 2.

established.name: Recreational team sport (such as ultimate frisbee)
Endurance training (running and other steady aerobic exercise)
Music (listening, making music and music therapy)
Dance (social and recreational dance and dance movement therapy)
